data.body:
[P2] Persist the admitted manifest before starting adapter work

Neither branch fsyncs the manifest contents: an existing manifest is only read, and `_write_new_manifest()` only writes and closes it. The subsequent journal fsync does not guarantee persistence of another file's contents. A crash after a successfully journaled dispatch can therefore leave durable attempts beside an empty manifest, losing the profile, resource, and artifact binding needed to recover the run. Flush and fsync the manifest, including a matching caller-supplied file, and sync its parent directory before loading the adapter. Extend the persistence tests to verify this ordering.
